notes:
Lead source: self-serve signup + inbound web chat. CTO (Anya Patel) signed up, used trial credits to run basic text gen. Interested mainly in hosted API (keep infra off their plate).

Discovery notes / timeline:
- 2026-01-10: created account via signup form; trial credits auto-applied.
- 2026-01-12: short demo email from Maya (AE) — intro + ask about latency targets.
- 2026-02-03: intro call with Maya + Liam (SE). Fireflies: ff_2026-02-18_BQ_intro (transcript pending).

- 2026-02-18: technical deep-dive (45m): discussed streaming vs chunked responses, prefix caching ideas. Action: SE to run p95 latency tests against hosted endpoint with 128-token context.

Use-case & requirements (from CTO / eng notes):
- Primary: in-app chat assistant embedded in B2B SaaS product (support + contextual help).
- Must feel "instant" on mobile: desire p50 < 100ms first-byte, p95 < 300ms for common queries.
- Streaming mandatory (progressive partial responses improves UX).
- Throughput moderate: 20–40 concurrent active users during peak, bursts up to 200.
- Cost sensitive: early-stage, want predictable per-request cost + guidance for batching/caching.
- Model preference: open-model or Redwood-curated small/medium model with streaming support; willing to evaluate quantized variants if latency improves.
- Routing: single-region NA preferred; fallbacks to lower-cost model OK when load spikes.

Security / compliance:
- SOC2 desired (company is in process of prepping SOC2).
- SSO/SAML required for admin UI.
- Audit logs for prompt history retention requested (30–90 days). Not high-data-residency concerns now.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We need it to feel like typing — partial tokens streaming in, not big pauses." — Anya, CTO
- "If we can get predictable token pricing and a straightforward streaming sample for iOS, we can push to prod fast." — Head of Product

POC plan (agreed):
- SE: provide API test keys + sample iOS streaming client repo (forkable) by 2026-02-28.
- BlueQuartz: integrate SDK and run 1 week of live traffic in staging (target 20–30 concurrent) to validate p95 latency.
- Evaluate cost run-rate and decide between pay-as-you-go Hosted or upgrade to Dedicated if sustained higher throughput / SLOs required.

Open questions / AE notes:
- Need to confirm exact token pricing for streaming mode (per-byte vs per-token for incremental chunks).
- Legal asked for basic data processing addendum — AE to send standard DPA link. (Drive: pricing + DPA stub)
- They mentioned trying OpenAI previously but experienced jitter on mobile streaming. Looking for more predictable latency.

- 3) Schedule follow-up POC review (tentative 2026-03-12).
